name: @collaboration-operations-platform/database
description: Database schema and atomic job queue for Collaboration Operations Platform

scripts.migrations:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('migrations/manifest.json','utf8')); const missing=manifest.map(item=>'migrations/' + item.filename).filter(file=>!fs.existsSync(file)); if(missing.length){console.error('missing migration files: '+missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('migration files present');"
